description: Conectividad de Alta Velocidad is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones - MinTIC, Bogotá D.C.. El proyecto de Conectividad de Alta Velocidad-PNCAV busca conectar 28 cabeceras municipales y 19 corregimientos departamentales a través del despliegue de redes de alta velocidad, satelitales y/o terrestres, beneficiando aproximadamente 441.000 personas ubicadas en la selva colombiana. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones - MinTIC, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are conectividad, internet, red, velocidad. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación. The portal shows 2023-11-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
